changelog: REDDOT Workstation v3.0 UI/UX Architecture: Complete industrial redesign inspired by IBM Carbon and high-performance mission control systems.
Executive Daily Pulse Dashboard: Circular live SVG gauge ring, 4 executive KPI metric cards, priority objectives, and real-time team activity stream.
Iconic Left Navigation Rail: High-density workspace navigation with live CPU allocation telemetry.
Precision Attendance Log & Hero Card: Massive clock display, 8-hour shift quota progress bar, and one-click cryptographically auditable CSV export.
Engineering Nodes Matrix: Deep personnel telemetry, target architecture badges, active directives, and instant node provisioning.
Sprint 14 Execution Cycle: Sprint progress banner, prioritized work streams, and interactive slide-out task detail drawer with subtasks checklist.
Dual-Theme Engine: Seamless switching between Clean Carbon Light Mode and Obsidian Crimson Dark Mode (Alt+T shortcut).
Universal Omnibox Search: Global shortcut (Ctrl+K) for instant keyboard-driven search across tasks, engineering nodes, and system commands.
Hardware Function Keys: Instant F7 (Take Break) and F8 (Clock Out) desktop shortcut bindings.
